description: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the CONTENT baseline defaults every video gets (unless it is the A/B arm under test) AND the default-promotion policy (human AND autonomous). Read by the TS designer (hermes/src/defaults.ts -> design.ts) to build the control/baseline video + derive test-arm deviations, and by the Python promotion engine (hermes-nous/sffs/promote.py) to detect proposals, auto-promote confirmed winners, and auto-revert underperformers. `defaults`/`history` are written by (a) the HUMAN approval CLI (sffs_promote_default --approve <id>) AND (b) the AUTONOMOUS gate (promote.auto_promote_cycle) — but the autonomous path is stricter and reversible: it only adopts a winner AFTER a confirmation round of fresh matured samples, logs every promotion + revert to the reversible auto_ledger (in proposals.json, surfaced on the dashboard), and AUTO-REVERTS a promoted default that later underperforms the arm it replaced. GUARDRAIL: promotion only ever writes an arm LABEL from the fixed whitelist here; it touches NO posting/scheduling/window/ceiling/gate path, so a promoted default can never change cadence or escape the hard posting guardrails (7am-1am CST, <=12/day/platform, quality/brand gates, dedup, do-not-touch). This is the CONTENT analog of the code factory's two-key gate.

defaults_meaning.narration: Arm label of the current NARRATION default. 'full' = the cloned-voice host reads every question + options aloud on EVERY video. Deviation test arms: no-narration | no-question-vo | no-options-vo.
defaults_meaning.ending: Arm label of the current ENDING default. 'cliffhanger' = reveal the early questions but leave the LAST one unresolved + comment-CTA, no score screen (on a 1-question video this collapses to withholding that single verdict + comment-CTA). Deviation test arms: full-reveal | no-answer.
defaults_meaning.mascot: Arm label of the current MASCOT default. 'mascot-prominent' = the brand brain mascot ENLARGED (bigger on the intro cover + outro) on EVERY new video by default -- a MANUAL, belief-driven promotion (owner decision; mascot view data still inconclusive). Deviation/control test arms kept running as a minority: mascot-absent (hide the brain -- the clean no-mascot counterfactual) | mascot-standard (today's size). Measured PRIMARILY on VIEWS (see promotion.metric_by_dimension); the retained absent control + reversible ledger are the safety net.

promotion.metric_units: percent (median 3-second skip rate from Metricool reelsSkipRate; LOWER IS BETTER)
promotion.notes: PROMOTION JUDGES ON 3-SECOND SKIP RATE, LOWER IS BETTER. It previously judged on median_eng_rate with a median_views override for mascot. Both were wrong for this account: reach here is bimodal and views are unreliable at this sample size, while inside the test batch skip rate predicts reach at -0.51 and watch time manages a non-significant +0.21. Judging on views at n=8 could adopt a new default off pure noise. min_sample raised 5 -> 12 for the same reason: 5 is not enough arms to distinguish a real effect from the spread we are actually seeing. Skip rate is INSTAGRAM-ONLY -- Metricool exposes no TikTok watch-time data at all -- which is consistent with Instagram being the only channel posting right now.

auto_promotion.notes: AUTONOMOUS default-promotion policy (promote.auto_promote_cycle). Deliberately STRICTER than the human `promotion` gate: min_sample=8 (vs 5) matured posts on BOTH sides. TWO-STAGE, reversible: STAGE 1 a winner that clears these thresholds enters a confirmation round; STAGE 2 it is only auto-adopted after >= confirmation_min_new_samples FRESH matured challenger samples accrue with the win still holding (a confirmation round of similar posts). Every promotion + revert is appended to proposals.json `auto_ledger` (surfaced on the dashboard) and is reversible. AUTO-REVERT: if a promoted default later underperforms the arm it replaced by >= revert_abs_drop_pp over >= revert_min_sample matured posts, it is automatically reverted. Set enabled=false to fall back to human-only approval. Promotion NEVER touches posting/scheduling — it only flips a whitelisted arm label — so it can never escape the hard posting guardrails.

replication.notes: DEMOTED AND DISABLED as of 2026-07-28. The campaign moved to chasing a breakout, and replication interpolates around the best existing post -- it structurally cannot produce a much bigger one. It also manufactures near-copies, which is a plausible contributor to TikTok's unoriginal-content suppression. Disabling here is the durable form of the revert: with enabled=false the designer sees no directive regardless of what the ledger holds, so a stray --detect cannot quietly re-open a round. The engine and its ledger are left intact; flip enabled back to true to resume. WINNER-REPLICATION policy (hermes-nous/sffs/replicate.py). The promotion gate above judges arms on median_eng_rate and structurally CANNOT see a REACH-only winner; this detects one and doubles down on its style. A style qualifies when it beats its own platform rolling median reach by >= min_ratio_vs_median over >= min_baseline_samples matured posts AND clears min_absolute (so a soft median cannot mint a fake outlier); scoring is per-platform because TikTok and Instagram run on different scales. The round then holds the winning STYLE constant and varies only secondary knobs (hashtags/tempo/time-of-day) so a repeat win is attributable. After maturity_hours it escalates by escalation_step or, if the replicas fall to <= revert_ratio of the median, reverts and logs a fluke. winner_share_cap is a HARD EXPLORATION FLOOR clamped to 0.5 in code: replication may never take more than half a batch, so the loop never stops sampling new styles. Everything is reversible via the ledger in ab-testing/replication.json (sffs_replicate --revert). Replication expresses a PREFERENCE about which styles get batch slots; it touches NO posting/scheduling/window/cap/gate path.

experiment_lock.notes: Until the deadline the OPENING dimension belongs to the controlled A/B (ops/resume_posting.mjs), not to Hermes's free rotation. Hermes may still vary other dimensions, but any dimension it varies must be BALANCED ACROSS BOTH HOOK ARMS rather than free-running: if narration, tempo, mascot or question mix drift with the arm, the skip-rate comparison this week was resequenced to produce dissolves into a confound. After 2026-07-30T17:12:00Z the lock expires and rotation is free again -- it is a date, not a permanent restriction.
